newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice futures end mixed, liquidation hits July.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice futures end mixed, liquidation hits July.

text.p: CBOT rice futures ended mixed Friday, with July delivery down on bear spreads tied to liquidation of the contract, traders said.
Trade sources said all eyes were on the new-crop months, leaving little interest in the July just three weeks ahead of first notice day.
New crop continued to draw support from concerns of slow crop development and ideas a short monsoon season in India would cut production there.
Rice ended five cents lower to two cents higher, with July down five at $11.52 per cwt.
Volume was estimated by CBOT at 300 lots versus Thursday's actual volume of 179 lots.
